% test-marginnote's cases with hyperref, and sidenotes' \sidenote, which
% uses \marginpar without an offset and \marginnote with one.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{sidenotes}
\input{test-marginnote-cases.ltx}

\begingroup
\sidenote{\tiny\color{blue}Note sidenote.}\after{sidenote}
\endgroup

\begingroup
\sidenote[][1em]{\tiny\color{blue}Note sideoffset.}\after{sideoffset}
\endgroup
\end{document}
